Container.Name: print-buddy
Container.Overview:
Print Buddy is an offline-capable assistant for managing 3D printer workflows. This template runs the standalone Discord bot. It does not start a printer, connect to a printer, or enable the optional Moonraker event listener.
The variables below are the ones the 2.1.1 image actually reads: they mirror the Docker Compose / DockerMan contract in the print-buddy repository (docker-compose.yml, .env.example and docker/unraid/print-buddy-bot.xml). The Discord token is the DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN secret, the channel is PRINT_BUDDY__DISCORD__CHAT_ID, and PRINT_BUDDY_ORCA_CHANNEL selects the bundled OrcaSlicer channel at startup. Earlier revisions of this template used PRINT_BUDDY__BOT__* names (token, application/guild/channel/role IDs) that are not Print Buddy settings; the settings loader rejects unknown PRINT_BUDDY__* variables, so a container created from them failed to start.
Image tag 2.1.1 selects the published amd64 build verified by GitHub Actions run 40215865983. The plain version tag is used for Community Applications scanner compatibility. Anonymous registry access verified digest sha256:1a958282f0451be748c76c5102c982ea358ed8b02f4fe4eede549de8a1c86488; build evidence identifies version 2.1.1 and source revision bd21489d41221296918491acd96af7ef031d702e.

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: Runtime state, prompts, hardware and job records. Back this up.

Config.Name: Archive
Config.Description: Sliced jobs and G-code. Back this up.

Config.Name: Settings file
Config.Description: Leave as is, or point at a mounted YAML file for list settings.

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: Secret. The bot reads its token from this variable.

Config.Name: Allowed user IDs
Config.Description: Discord user IDs allowed to use the bot, comma or space separated.

Config.Name: Moonraker URL
Config.Description: Klipper printers, for example http://printer.example:7125. Fluidd is not needed here.

Config.Name: Spoolman URL
Config.Description: Included Spoolman container by default. Set an existing external Spoolman, for example http://spoolman.example:8000, to use that instead; nothing is migrated.

Config.Name: OrcaSlicer channel
Config.Description: Bundled OrcaSlicer channel selected at startup: stable (default) or alpha. Any other value stops the container.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, an IANA name such as UTC. Print Buddy schedules use the discord.timezone setting; TZ covers container logs and the OS clock.
